## desc

Fixed row height

## purpose

Virtualize fixed-height table rows.

## behavior

Uses the native table row provider and body scroll slot with SaigonScroll; reserves row height and can animate mounted cells. Expanded detail rows disable the fixed virtual path.

## prerequisites

Requires a bounded body viewport and stable configured row height.

## caveats

Use a supported animation name string or false; the current animation callback calls string methods on a truthy value. Variable-height details do not use the same fixed-row virtualization path.

Prose fields not supplied: `comment`, `appearance`, `lifecycle`, `composition`.
